dist_pu.rationale: the profile ID names the algorithm the matrix already registers, so it inherits that entry unchanged

genpu.rationale: P4.2b: registered as no_direct_anchor -- the paper reports MNIST/USPS dense-net generators (Table 1) and PU-Bench's cgenpu is a variant of the method, not this row, so no spambase/imdb/cifar10 cell has a published number

holistic_pu.rationale: PU-Bench Table 1 reports Holistic-PU on all three datasets v3 runs (D41/P4.2a)

kldce.rationale: the registry excludes this profile from running under survey-v3.0, but the matrix still holds its three non-runnable marker rows, so the profile is mapped rather than outside the matrix

lagam.rationale: PU-Bench Table 1 reports LaGAM-PU on all three datasets v3 runs (D41/P4.2a)

lbe.rationale: the profile ID names the algorithm the matrix already registers, so it inherits that entry unchanged

nnpu.rationale: the profile ID names the algorithm the matrix already registers, so it inherits that entry unchanged

pn_oracle.rationale: the profile ID names the algorithm the matrix already registers, so it inherits that entry unchanged

pulda.rationale: PU-Bench Table 1 reports PULDA on all three datasets v3 runs (D41/P4.2a)

pulns.rationale: P4.2b: registered as no_direct_anchor -- the paper reports test error over a gamma axis with its own true-label validation set as a training signal, not our SCAR c grid and accuracy

pusb_kernel.rationale: the profile ID names the algorithm the matrix already registers, so it inherits that entry unchanged

robust_pu.rationale: PU-Bench Table 1 reports Robust-PU on all three datasets v3 runs (D41/P4.2a)

self_pu.rationale: profile is the no-meta ablation the v4 entry describes

deviations.note: the paper's full self-calibrated training uses clean validation labels; PU-Bench's controlled entry uses unlabeled validation inputs instead

self_pu_full_meta.rationale: same algorithm as self_pu with the paper's clean-validation self-calibration, so it inherits the entry and deviates only from the PU-Bench meta target

split_pu.rationale: P4.2b: registered as no_direct_anchor -- the paper reports CIFAR-10 accuracy at fixed n_P with official weak/strong augmentation and test-label monitoring, none of which this row reproduces

upu.rationale: the profile ID names the algorithm the matrix already registers, so it inherits that entry unchanged
